summary: Iteration 69 - Customer Accounts Feature Testing Complete. Backend: 17/17 tests passed. Frontend: All features verified working.
seed_data_creation: None - tests create and cleanup TEST_ prefixed data
context_for_next_testing_agent: Customer accounts feature fully tested: (1) Backend CRUD at /api/customers with auto-guest linking works correctly. (2) Search by name/phone/email via ?search= parameter works. (3) GET /api/customers/{id} includes purchase history from sales collection. (4) POST /api/sales with customer_id correctly increments customer total_purchases and total_spent via $inc. (5) GET /api/customers/{id}/purchases returns purchase list with totals. (6) Sales portal has customer search input in cart section (placeholder: 'Customer name/phone...'). (7) customersApi in api.js has all methods: list/get/create/update/delete/purchases. (8) All major pages (Dashboard, Members, Events, Financial) load correctly.

customer_crud.notes: All CRUD operations work correctly. Create auto-sets location_id from active campus. Name is required field.

customer_search.notes: Search works by name, phone, and email using regex case-insensitive matching

customer_purchases.notes: Returns purchases array, total_count, and total_spent

customer_totals_update.notes: Sale with customer_id correctly increments total_purchases by 1 and total_spent by sale total using $inc

auto_guest_linking.notes: When creating customer with email/phone matching existing guest, guest_id is auto-linked and guest marked is_customer=true

sales_portal_customer_search.notes: Customer search input in cart section with placeholder 'Customer name/phone...'. Calls GET /api/customers?search=. Selected customer linked to sale via customer_id.

customers_api_frontend.notes: customersApi has all methods: list, get, create, update, delete, purchases

major_pages.notes: All major pages load correctly. Sales portal requires separate last_name + PIN authentication.
